4.2.9 The imports node

The imports tag below the package tag contains one import tag for each content file to import file belonging to the package. No other tags should appear below the imports tag.

Example:

<imports>  
  <import file="rtl.xct"/>  
  <import file="fcl.xct"/>  
</imports>
